title: Plum Black Rice & 10% Niacinamide-TXA Night Clarity Jelly Serum
shortDescription: Plum's Black Rice & Niacinamide-TXA 10% Night Clarity Jelly Serum combines 7% Niacinamide and 3% Tranexamic Acid to reduce dark spots, post-acne marks, and pigmentation overnight.
description:
Plum's Black Rice & Niacinamide-TXA 10% Night Clarity Jelly Serum combines 7% Niacinamide and 3% Tranexamic Acid to reduce dark spots, post-acne marks, and pigmentation overnight. The ActiveHold™ Jelly Formula creates a breathable, long-contact layer that maximises ingredient absorption while skin repairs itself at night. Powered by 20% Black Rice Extract from Northeast India, rich in antioxidants. Suitable for all skin types.

Pigmentation and stubborn acne marks are among the toughest skin concerns, because breakouts may fade, but the marks often stay behind. Plum's Black Rice & Niacinamide-TXA 10% Night Clarity Jelly Serum combines 7% Niacinamide and 3% Tranexamic Acid to target pigmentation through multiple pathways, helping visibly reduce dark spots, stubborn acne marks, and improve overall skin clarity. Powered by 20% proprietary Black Rice Extract sourced from Northeast India, this antioxidant-rich night serum comes in a first-of-its-kind ActiveHold™ Jelly Formula that forms a breathable, long-contact layer on the skin to help maximise overnight efficacy while your skin is in repair mode.
highlights: Fades dark spots & pigmentation — 7% Niacinamide + 3% TXA work on two separate melanin pathways
ActiveHold™ Jelly Formula — long-contact breathable layer for deeper overnight absorption
20% Black Rice Extract — antioxidant-rich, sourced from Northeast India
